evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Speaker controls and supplies the decision fact itself, exercising informational power by declaring the migration as settled.
Evidence-and-logic argument for the switch, with the promised benefits (performance, cost savings) functioning as offered rewards.
Memo author frames the migration as an established fact via a terse arrow notation, supplying the decision as informational.
Quantified performance claim presented as evidentiary justification for the decision.
Stating a specific deadline imposes temporal pressure on the migration's execution.
